title: Understanding the Dataset
text: The dataset contains information about what each student ate for lunch, including the types of food, the number of servings, and the total calories. Each row represents one lunch for a student.

title: Bootstrap Sampling
text: In bootstrap sampling, we draw samples with replacement from the dataset. The size of each sample should match the number of rows in the original dataset.
